cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(CloudGITouchscreen LANGUAGES C CXX)
if(NOT WIN32 OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Build for Windows x64, including when the managed Host targets ARM64.")
endif()
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(MSVC)
  set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
  add_compile_options(/W4 /utf-8)
else()
  add_compile_options(-fms-extensions -Wall -Wextra -Wno-missing-field-initializers)
  add_link_options(-static)
endif()
add_compile_definitions(UNICODE _UNICODE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX)
add_library(minhook STATIC minhook/src/buffer.c minhook/src/hook.c minhook/src/trampoline.c minhook/src/hde/hde64.c)
target_include_directories(minhook PUBLIC minhook/include)
add_library(CloudGI.Touchscreen SHARED src/Touchscreen.cpp src/Scanner/Scanner.cpp)
target_link_libraries(CloudGI.Touchscreen PRIVATE minhook psapi)
set_target_properties(CloudGI.Touchscreen PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
add_executable(CloudGI.MobileUI src/Launcher.cpp)
if(MINGW)
  target_link_options(CloudGI.MobileUI PRIVATE -municode)
endif()
option(CLOUDGI_TOUCH_TESTS "Build owned-process integration fixtures; never real games" OFF)
if(CLOUDGI_TOUCH_TESTS)
  if(MINGW)
    enable_language(ASM)
    add_executable(HookFixture WIN32 tests/HookFixture.cpp tests/HookFixture.S)
    target_link_options(HookFixture PRIVATE -municode)
    add_executable(HookFixtureNoCallback WIN32 tests/HookFixture.cpp tests/HookFixture.S)
    target_compile_definitions(HookFixtureNoCallback PRIVATE CLOUDGI_NO_CALLBACK)
    target_link_options(HookFixtureNoCallback PRIVATE -municode)
  endif()
  add_executable(UnsupportedFixture WIN32 tests/HookFixture.cpp)
  target_compile_definitions(UnsupportedFixture PRIVATE CLOUDGI_NO_SIGNATURES)
  if(MINGW)
    target_link_options(UnsupportedFixture PRIVATE -municode)
  endif()
endif()
